Component Name / Description: Arduino Mega 2560 Rev3 (Clone) - Main microcontroller board for running game logic and driving the screen and inputs
2.4 inch TFT LCD Touch Display - Screen for rendering game graphics, player ship, and score UI
2-Axis Thumb Joystick Module (SF9032) - 2-axis analog control for spaceship movement and dodging
4-Pin Tactile Switch (6x6x4.5mm) - Action buttons for firing lasers, deploying missiles, and game controls
830 Tie-Point Solderless Breadboard - Prototyping board for component connections (Note: A smaller breadboard can also be used)
Jumper Wires - Interconnecting power and signal lines between components
